question: Should maintainers accept focused runner/Codex proof after a clean current-main port, or require live Codex app-server wedge proof before merging this lane-release fix?
rationale: The source-level fix shape is credible, but the branch is currently conflicting and the remaining decision is proof sufficiency for session/message overlap risk rather than a narrow mechanical review finding.

options.title: Port And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Refresh the branch on current main, preserve current abort semantics, rerun focused and required checks, and accept the runner/Codex regression proof for this bug slice.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live or Crabbox Codex app-server wedge demonstrates that late cleanup does not corrupt session state or channel-visible delivery.

options.title: Replace In Broader Recovery Work
options.body: Close or replace this branch if maintainers prefer to fold Codex lane release into a broader current-main recovery effort.

recommendation.title: Port And Accept Focused Proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch on current main, preserve current abort semantics, rerun focused and required checks, and accept the runner/Codex regression proof for this bug slice.
